title: Health Monitoring
subtitle: Record observations and review health history
rulesDisclaimer: Warnings come from simple rules (high temperature, low appetite, low activity, multiple symptoms). They highlight animals to check and do not diagnose disease.

simpleFlagNote: Simple rule-based flag, not a diagnosis.
